decision: Whom should the coach name as team captain?
context: Candidate one is the best player and rarely talks. Candidate two is a vocal veteran who plays less. Candidate three is the quiet, newer defender whom teammates seek out for advice. The team lost four of the last six matches.

options.name: star
options.text: The best player

options.name: veteran
options.text: The vocal veteran

options.name: defender
options.text: The defender teammates seek out

decision: How should a small museum set ticket prices?
context: The museum has 20,000 visitors a year, with a mix of tourists and schools, and is open 6 days. Costs rose by 12 percent. Local residents are 40 percent of visits.

options.name: flat
options.text: Raise all tickets by 12 percent

options.name: resident
options.text: Raise tourist prices and keep resident prices

options.name: freeday
options.text: Add a free day each month and raise standard prices

options.name: membership
options.text: Introduce a yearly membership and keep single prices

options.name: donation
options.text: Switch to pay-what-you-want

decision: How should a school help seven-year-olds who are behind in reading?
context: Eight pupils out of 60 are behind. The school has two teaching assistants and 30 minutes of spare time daily. Parents are open to helping at home.

options.name: smallgroup
options.text: Daily small-group phonics with a teaching assistant

options.name: homeread
options.text: Send books home and ask parents to read nightly

options.name: tablet
options.text: Give the pupils a reading app on tablets

options.name: wait
options.text: Wait until the end of the year to see if they catch up

decision: How should the animal shelter schedule its weekend volunteers?
context: The shelter has 40 volunteers, 25 dogs, and 14 cats. Mornings are busiest. Many volunteers can come only once a month, and the manager is on site only Saturday mornings.

options.name: fixedteam
options.text: Fixed teams of five who each cover one weekend a month

options.name: signup
options.text: An online sign-up sheet with minimum numbers per shift

options.name: pairs
options.text: Pairing each new volunteer with an experienced one on set days

decision: Which new flavor should an ice cream stall add for summer?
context: The stall sells 200 cones a day. The customers are mostly families with children, and surveys of 80 customers show 41 ask for a strawberry flavor, 9 for pistachio, and 6 for blue cheese. Strawberries are cheap this season.

options.name: pistachio
options.text: Pistachio

options.name: strawberry
options.text: Strawberry

options.name: bluecheese
options.text: Blue cheese

decision: Which route should a pair of hikers take on a three-day trek?
context: The pair hikes 18 km a day comfortably. The forecast is dry for two days then uncertain. One route has a high pass with views, one follows a valley with villages, and one is a ridge walk with a hut.

options.name: pass
options.text: The high pass route with two nights in huts

options.name: valley
options.text: The valley route with village guesthouses

options.name: ridge
options.text: The ridge walk with a hut and a possible exit path

options.name: loop
options.text: A loop from one base camp with day hikes

decision: How should a small startup authenticate its mobile app users?
context: The app has 5,000 users, one backend developer, and a 3-week deadline. Users are consumers with email addresses. The team wants social sign-in as an option.

options.name: own
options.text: Build email and password login with session cookies

options.name: hosted
options.text: Use a hosted identity service with social sign-in

options.name: magic
options.text: Email magic links only

options.name: devicetoken
options.text: Anonymous device tokens with optional upgrade later

decision: How should a neighbourhood tool library track loans?
context: The library has 300 tools, 120 members, and is run by volunteers on Saturdays. Some tools are expensive, and about 5 percent go missing each year.

options.name: notebook
options.text: A paper ledger signed at each loan

options.name: app
options.text: A free lending app with QR codes

options.name: deposit
options.text: A refundable deposit for tools above 50 euros

options.name: trust
options.text: No tracking, relying on trust

decision: Which flight should a traveller book to reach an 8 am meeting abroad?
context: The meeting is on Tuesday 8 am in the destination city. Flight one arrives Monday 6 pm. Flight two lands Tuesday 7 am and the airport is 50 minutes from the venue. Flight three arrives Tuesday 9 am. A late flight is useless if the meeting is missed.

options.name: monday
options.text: The flight landing Monday at 6 pm

options.name: tuesday7
options.text: The flight landing Tuesday at 7 am

options.name: tuesday9
options.text: The flight landing Tuesday at 9 am

decision: What should the owner build around a vegetable plot to keep rabbits out?
context: The plot is 4 by 6 metres, the owner wants it to last at least 10 years, and the budget is 250 euros. Rabbits dig and the plot is in a windy spot.

options.name: wire
options.text: Galvanised wire mesh buried 30 cm and 90 cm high

options.name: wood
options.text: A wooden picket fence with a wire skirt

options.name: electric
options.text: A battery-powered electric fence

options.name: raised
options.text: Raised beds with mesh lids

decision: Which activity should the library offer teenagers on Friday evenings?
context: The library has 25 free seats, a budget of 200 euros for the term, and a staff member who can supervise. Surveys of 30 teenagers had board games first, followed by film nights and homework help.

options.name: boardgames
options.text: Board game evenings with a games library

options.name: film
options.text: Film nights with snacks

options.name: homework
options.text: Supervised homework help

options.name: tournament
options.text: Video game tournaments on borrowed consoles

options.name: workshop
options.text: Craft workshops led by volunteers

decision: How should a runner return after a stress fracture in the shin?
context: The doctor cleared pain-free walking after 8 weeks. The runner was running 60 km weekly before. The physio recommends a staged return and cross-training.

options.name: fullmileage
options.text: Return straight to 60 km a week

options.name: staged
options.text: Alternate walking and running in small steps, with swimming and cycling

options.name: race
options.text: Enter a 10 km race in two weeks as motivation

options.name: stop
options.text: Stop running for another year

decision: How should a freelance photographer store client photos?
context: The photographer has 4 TB of images, with 300 GB added every year. Clients request old photos about 10 times a year. The budget for storage is 25 euros a month.

options.name: cloud
options.text: A cloud storage plan with sharing links

options.name: drives
options.text: Two external drives, one stored off-site

options.name: nas
options.text: A home network storage box with a mirrored pair of disks

options.name: archive
options.text: A cloud archive tier plus one local drive for the last year

decision: How should a club handle a member who repeatedly disrupts meetings by shouting?
context: The club has a written code of conduct, and the member has been warned twice. Several members have said they will leave if nothing changes. The committee has the power to suspend members.

options.name: ignore
options.text: Ignore it and hope it fades

options.name: suspend
options.text: Follow the code with a time-limited suspension and a written notice

options.name: vote
options.text: Put the question to all members in a vote

decision: How should a renter grow herbs on a north-facing balcony?
context: The balcony gets about 2 hours of direct sun in summer. The renter can hang pots on the railing, and has 80 euros.

options.name: pots
options.text: Pots of mint, parsley, and chives on the railing

options.name: lights
options.text: Grow lights indoors on a shelf

options.name: basil
options.text: A tray of basil and rosemary

options.name: windowbox
options.text: A window box of thyme and oregano

options.name: skip
options.text: Buy herbs from the shop

decision: When should an orchard owner prune old apple trees?
context: The 40 trees are 30 years old and overgrown. The owner has two weekends free in winter and one in late summer. Several trees show canker.

options.name: winter
options.text: Prune in mid-winter on a dry day

options.name: latewinter
options.text: Prune in late winter just before buds open

options.name: summer
options.text: Prune lightly in summer after growth stops

options.name: split
options.text: Prune cankered branches in summer and the rest in winter

decision: How should a batch job process records that fail with a permanent validation error?
context: Records arrive 10,000 a minute. A permanent error means the record is malformed and will never succeed. A retry loop on those records has caused a backlog before. Operators want to inspect the bad records later.

options.name: retryforever
options.text: Retry forever with a short delay

options.name: dlq
options.text: Move it to a dead-letter store with the error and continue

options.name: crash
options.text: Stop the whole job and page someone

options.name: drop
options.text: Drop the record silently

decision: What gift should a family buy for a grandfather turning 80?
context: He likes birdwatching and old maps, has poor hearing, and lives alone in a quiet village. The family has 150 euros and lives 3 hours away.

options.name: binoculars
options.text: Lightweight binoculars with a field guide

options.name: tablet
options.text: A tablet to video call the family

options.name: map
options.text: A framed antique map of his region

options.name: dinner
options.text: A family dinner at a restaurant

options.name: radio
options.text: A digital radio

options.name: voucher
options.text: A garden-centre voucher
